description:
Service Agreement for Eppendorf epMotion 5075


PACKAGE SHOULD INCLUDE:

This service agreement for Eppendorf epMotion 5075 including a full annual preventive maintenance service program for assured instrument reliability and uptime; parts, labor, and travel included, 10 % discount on  additional services (e.g. IQ/OQ) during the agreement period
- Cleaning and checking of housing and accessories
- Evaluation of stored data software update
- Checking and calibration of ejector tip, level sensor and carrier
- Checking barcode scanner with epBlue ID if applicable- Checking TMX module with Magnetic Finger module if applicable
- Checking UV light and CleanCap (HEPA Filter) if applicable- Exchange of CAN bus cables/O-rings of dispensing tools, if applicable
- Calibration/Adjustment of device specific modules, if applicable.
